obligations.statement: Define xi and Li coefficients lambda_n in derivative form
Prove the zero-sum representation with the exact symmetric limiting convention
Map an off-line zero quartet to a transformed member z_rho=1-1/rho with |z_rho|>1; specifically Re(rho)<1/2 iff |z_rho|>1, while Re(rho)>1/2 iff |z_rho|<1
Prove an off-line zero family forces a finite n with lambda_n<0 after controlling the complete zero sum
Emit a finite witness certificate containing n, exact lambda_n definition, and proof lambda_n<0

non_substitution_rules: A single off-line term with large modulus is not enough; the complete symmetrically grouped zero sum must be controlled.
A floating-point negative approximation is not an exact negative certificate.
The detector criterion cannot be reused as the independent positivity barrier.
Finite-model dominance does not automatically transfer to the infinite zeta-zero multiset.
completion_criteria: All convergence, grouping, and multiplicity conventions explicit
